messages:
sam: Reports of resumed SSE connections landing on wrong shards and duplicate resume_charge after the CDN sanitize change rolled at 02:40. Short trace below.

lila: Can you paste a minimal repro and the headers you saw?

sam: Client example:
```
curl -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Last-Event-ID: ev-42" "https://api.redwood.example/stream?tenant=team-x"
```
Edge logs (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-24T02:41:03Z] cdn-edge: sanitize headers, dropped Last-Event-ID
[2026-03-24T02:41:03Z] proxy: route request -> shard-9 (no resume token)
[2026-03-24T02:41:04Z] runtime: resume lookup failed, creating new session -> emit resume_charge tenant=team-x
```

sam: Conclusion: CDN stripped Last-Event-ID which runtime interprets as resume token. That caused new sessions + billing dupes.

cdn-bot: cdn-config v1.8.0 rolled at 2026-03-24T02:40:00Z, rule: drop-unlisted-headers=true.

lila: Quick mitigations: 1) whitelist Last-Event-ID in CDN (hotfix), 2) runtime accept Last-Event-ID OR query resume param for resume lookup, 3) billing: add transient dedupe flag for resume_charge events where resume token was missing then present.

billing: We prefer flagged dedupe (no auto refunds) until legal signs off. Add evidence links in case disputes arise.

console-ui: We'll add a temporary "header-sanitization-detected" banner and a drilldown linking to traces when resume token mismatches are seen.

sam: Filed INF-4601 and added sample traces. cdn-team to hotfix whitelist. runtime to emit trace tag header_sanitized=true when header was dropped.

cdn-bot: hotfix v1.8.1 deployed to us-east-1 at 2026-03-24T02:52:10Z (sha: b12c).

lila: After hotfix, re-run 300-conn canary: no shard hops, resume_charge delta back to baseline. We'll leave dedupe flag on for 24h and monitor.

sam: Thanks all. Follow-ups: cdn-team add integration test to ensure needed SSE headers survive sanitize step; runtime team consider signed resume tokens.
